description: Keyword search across every Veil Press breaking story and Desk piece (headline, summary, tags and full text). Returns the best matches with url, published time, a snippet and a cite_as line.

query.description: Words to search for, e.g. "City of London Corporation" or "Treasury sanctions Iran".

section.description: breaking (news), desk (long-form reporting and history) or all (default).

since.description: Only stories published after this ISO 8601 time.

name: search_stories
